# Create a Signals Agent

Work out who you're looking for and set up an agent that keeps finding them.

Use for an ongoing search that keeps finding people, or working out who to target. Not for a one-off search (instant-lead-hunt), reviewing leads, pausing an agent or one quick setting change (do those directly).

**The user might say:** "Help me set up a Signals agent that keeps finding people for me. Help me work out who I'm looking for, test the searches, then show me the setup to approve."

## Steps

1. Existing agents and limits.
   ```sh
   xholic signals automation-setup
   ```
2. For a saved product, offer the one-step setup (only on approval).
   ```sh
   xholic signals find-customers --product-id <id>
   ```
3. Otherwise draft who to find.
   ```sh
   xholic signals draft-audience --mode product --product-id <id>
   ```
4. Where to look.
   ```sh
   xholic signals suggest-sources --audience-description "<agreed audience>"
   ```
5. Test the searches.
   ```sh
   xholic signals test-searches --queries "<query 1>" --queries "<query 2>"
   ```
6. Create it after the user approves the setup.
   ```sh
   xholic signals create-agent --json '<setup object>'
   ```
